_README: MASTER TUNING FILE. Change numbers here; no code needed. Restart the game to see changes.
game  = numbers that used to be written in the code (player base stats, stamina, monster rewards, respawns, spawns, item formulas, prices, arena).
files = overrides for the other files in data/. Anything written here WINS over the same value in that file (e.g. files > progression.json > scaling > hpExp).
Objects merge key by key; a list [ ... ] replaces the whole list. Only the values listed here are overridden; the rest of each file still applies.
Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored. Keep commas between entries and no comma after the last one, or the game cannot read the file (an error is logged).
Current values below are the game's values as of 2026-11-11.

player._help: Hero base stats. Max health = hpBase + level x hpPerLevel + Vitality x hpPerVit (+ gear, tree). Mana, stamina likewise. defensePerVit: armor per Vitality. critBase 0.05 = 5%. critDamage 1.8 = crits deal 180%. weaponBase: flat damage every weapon hit starts from (magicWeaponBase for wands and staves). spellPerMag / spellPerLevel: spell power per Magic / level. Regen per second. Potions heal this share of max health / mana.

stamina._help: Stamina cost of each action. Sprint drain and refill speed are in files > feel.json > move. twoHandedMul / daggerMul scale melee costs for two-handed weapons and daggers. blockPerDamage: stamina lost per point of damage blocked.

monsters._help: Rewards and respawns for every monster (stats and scaling are under files > enemies.json and files > progression.json). xp = base xp x (1 + xpPerLevel x (level-1)) x xpMul. Killing a monster more than lowLevelGap levels below you gives lowLevelXp of the xp. Gold = random between goldMin + level x goldMinPerLevel and goldMax + level x goldMaxPerLevel, x goldMul (bosses x bossGoldMul). itemChance: chance a normal monster drops an item (+ shadowItemChance in the Shadow realm, + upgradeItemChance per dungeon upgrade). Loot bonus raises rarity. respawn: seconds before an overworld monster comes back.

world._help: Area level = 1 + distance from Oakhaven / metresPerAreaLevel (+ shadowAreaBonus in the Shadow realm), at most maxAreaLevel. Overworld monsters are at least this level (they also follow your level: files > progression.json > overworld). lightCamps / shadowCamps: monster camps placed on the island when the world is built.

items._help: Item stats: [base, perLevel] -> (base + item level x perLevel) x rarity multiplier (files > items.json > rarityMult). Weapons: dmg for every type; wands and staves get less damage (wandDamageMul, staffDamageMul) but spell power (wandSpell, staffSpell, as a share: 0.06 = +6%). Hands give damage and trinkets defense only at Rare or better.

shop._help: Brynn's prices. Items cost value x buyMul + buyAdd (they sell for their value).

arena._help: Wave Survival: foes per wave = foesBase + wave x foesPerWave (at most maxFoes); foe level = your level + wave x levelsPerWave - 1. healBetweenWaves: share of max health restored after each wave. Valor rewards: files > valor.json.

progression.json._help: Levelling and monster scaling. See the _help notes inside data/progression.json for every field.

enemies.json._help: Monster base stats at level 1 (they grow with the scaling above). hp, dmg per blow, xp, spd (m/s), aggro (distance they notice you), cd (seconds between attacks), armor, mr (magic resist). More fields per monster in data/enemies.json.

loot.json._help: Drop rarity: weights for Common, Fine, Rare, Epic, Legendary; each point of loot bonus shifts weight toward rarer items (bonusPerPoint). Dungeon floors add bonusPerDepth per floor and bonusPerTier per 5-floor tier. Set gear: first floor (minDepth) and drop chances per kill (normal, upgraded 'elite', boss), +perDepth per floor deeper. Per-dungeon tables, uniques, scraps and crafting costs: data/loot.json.

items.json._help: Stat multiplier per rarity: Common, Fine, Rare, Epic, Legendary.

feel.json._help: Movement: run / sprint speed (m/s; if you change these, change avatar.json gait run/sprint by the same ratio so legs match), sprint stamina drain per second, delay before stamina refills, refill per second.

valor.json._help: Arena currency. Valor for clearing milestone waves, Shadow Duel rounds (duelPerRound x streak, at most duelMax), gacha pull costs.

wildlife.json._help: Animal herds: groups = herds on the island, size = [min, max] animals per herd.
